service_def.name: CostMap2D
service_def.description:
The Cost Map 2D Service provides a mechanism to report obstacles, hazardous terrain, and no-go zones using an overhead 2D cost map. The cost map is represented by a list of cells, broken into a specified number of rows and columns, which in turn corresponds to the width and height (respectively) of the map in meters. Each cell within the map specifies a cost value, and in some cases, a confidence value. The cost is a relative measure of occupancy or effort to traverse the cell, such that a value of zero (0) means no occupancy or no effort, while a maximum cost value means a cell is non-traversable. The center point of the cost map may be specified in global or local coordinates, depending on the particular implementation, as defined by [AS6009]. The map may also be rotated around the coordinate frame’s Z-axis by the specified yaw value.
Cells within the list must be sequenced such that the most northwest point, relative to the non-rotated coordinate frame, is the first element. Subsequent elements represent cells in an easterly direction, until the end of the row is reached. At that point, the next row starts again on the west side of the map.

service_def.assumptions: Messages may be delayed, lost, or reordered.

message_def.name: QueryCostMap2D
message_def.description: This message is used to query for cost map data. An optional maximum map size may be specified to limit the amount of data returned. If no values are specified, the service may still return a subset of the cost map stored internally, with emphasis on the immediate vicinity of the platform. An optional map center and orientation may be specified. If the map center lies outside the bounds of the known cost map, the data returned should reflect the unknown (zero confidence) elements. If the map center is specified in an unsupported coordinate frame, or the map center is not specified, the returned map should be based on the current vehicle location.

fixed_field.name: MapRotation
fixed_field.interpretation: Rotation about the global Z axis.

fixed_field.name: MapRotation
fixed_field.interpretation: Rotation about the local Z axis.

message_def.name: QueryNoGoZones
message_def.description: This message is used to query the vertex list for a specified no-go zone, or all zones.

fixed_field.name: ZoneID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the zone to be reported. If the specified value is zero (0), all zones will be reported.

message_def.name: AddNoGoZone
message_def.description: This message is used to request a client-specified no-go zone. Upon acceptance by the service, the cells traversed or contained by the polygon formed by imaginary lines connecting the sequenced list of vertices shall be considered maximum cost (non-traversable).

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: This value will be returned in the AddNoGoZoneResponse message to enable a client to match set and response pairs. The value is established by the client.

message_def.name: RemoveNoGoZone
message_def.description: This message is used to remove the specified no-go zone from the cost map. Once removed, the cells shall return to their normal values, or to an uncertain (zero confidence) state.

fixed_field.name: ZoneID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the zone to be reported. If the specified value is zero (0), all zones will be reported.

message_def.name: ReportCostMap2D
message_def.description: This message is used to report the cost map data in accordance to the received QueryCostMap2D message.

fixed_field.name: NumberOfRows
fixed_field.interpretation: Number of rows in the map data.

fixed_field.name: NumberOfColumns
fixed_field.interpretation: Number of columns in the map data.

fixed_field.name: MapWidth
fixed_field.interpretation: Total width of the cost map.

fixed_field.name: MapHeight
fixed_field.interpretation: Total height of the cost map.

fixed_field.name: Cost
fixed_field.interpretation: Value 0-254: A value of 0 indicates no cost (no restriction). A value of 254 means maximum cost (non-traversable or no-go zone). A value of 255 means the cost of the cell is known.

value_range.interpretation: Cost value associated with the cell. A value of 0 indicates no cost (no restriction). A value of 254 means maximum cost (non-traversable or no-go zone).
A value of 255 means the cost of the cell is unknown.

fixed_field.name: Cost
fixed_field.interpretation: Value 0-254: Cost value associated with the cell. A value of 0 indicates no cost (no restriction). A value of 254 means maximum cost (non-traversable or no-go zone). Value 255: A value of 255 is not allowed.

value_range.interpretation: Cost value associated with the cell.

fixed_field.name: Confidence
fixed_field.interpretation: Confidence value associated with the cost of the cell. A value of 0 means there is no confidence in the specified cost (unknown cost). A value of 100 means the cost of the cell is known perfectly.

sub_field.name: CostSubField
sub_field.interpretation: Cost value associated with the cell. A value of 0 indicates no cost (no restriction). A value of 7 means maximum cost (non-traversable or no-go zone).

bit_range.interpretation: CostSubField. Cost value associated with the cell. A value of 0 indicates no cost (no restriction). A value of 7 means maximum cost (non-traversable or no-go zone).

sub_field.name: CertaintySubField
sub_field.interpretation: A value of one (1) means the cost is known (valid). A value of zero means the costs in unknown (invalid).

bit_range.interpretation: CertaintySubField. A value of one (1) means the cost is known (valid). A value of zero means the costs in unknown (invalid).

sub_field.name: NumberCellsSubField
sub_field.interpretation: The number of cells, including this one, for which the cost and certainty apply.

bit_range.interpretation: The number of cells, including this one, for which the cost and certainty apply.

message_def.name: ReportNoGoZones
message_def.description: This message is used to report the no-go zones specified in the cost map.

fixed_field.name: ZoneID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID of the zone to be reported. If the specified value is zero (0), all zones will be reported.

message_def.name: AddNoGoZoneResponse
message_def.description: This message is used to report the success or failure for a corresponding AddNoGoZone message.

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: This value will be returned in the AddNoGoZoneResponse message to enable a client to match set and response pairs. The value is established by the client.

fixed_field.name: ZoneID
fixed_field.interpretation: This field shall be zero (invalid) unless the ResponseCode is zero (Success). Otherwise, Global ID of the newly defined no go zone.

action.interpretation: Add the given no go zone to the cost map, setting the cost of each cell traversed or contained by the polygon formed by imaginary lines connecting the sequenced list of vertices to the maximum value.

action.interpretation: Remove the specified no go zone from the map, returning each cell to their normal values or to an uncertain (zero confidence) state
